name: skein
description: The management page of a skein: create skeins, keep their locators in your wallet, install apps, register a handle and keep its certificate.

groupPermissions.description: Manage your skeins from this page.

protocolPermissions.description: Know your identity key: the skeins you own and the handles you hold are your key's.
Make the nonces of your sessions with skeins.
Sign your session with each skein you open.
Lock the locators of your skeins (a 1-sat PushDrop output each).
Sign a handle's registration on a skein host.
Keep the handle certificate a skein host issues you.
List the handle certificates you keep.
Sign your handle's profile (a name and an avatar).

basketAccess.description: Your skeins: list, add and remove their locators.

counterpartyPermissions.description: A skein, or a skein host's certifier, this page talks to for the first time.

protocols.description: Read the handle certificates it issued you.
